category: IP geolocation database download and web service

free_tier.stated: GeoLite Country, City and ASN databases in MMDB and CSV with up to 30 database downloads a day, and GeoLite Country and City web services at 1,000 lookups a day per service, free with a MaxMind account
free_tier.notes: two meters: database downloads a day and web-service lookups a day; lookups against a downloaded database are not metered

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: the database file sizes are shown only in the account portal

retention.stated: a downloaded GeoLite database must be replaced and the old copy deleted within 30 days of each new release

interface_detail: database permalinks at download.maxmind.com/geoip/databases/{edition}/download?suffix=... with HTTP basic auth (account ID and license key), redirected to presigned Cloudflare R2 URLs; geoipupdate reads the same credentials from GeoIP.conf; the GeoLite web services take the same account ID and license key
tooling: MaxMind's geoipupdate program (also a Docker image), curl or wget with basic auth, MaxMind client APIs, any MMDB reader
chaining: one account and license key give the City, Country and ASN databases for unmetered local lookups, refreshed by geoipupdate within the 30-day replacement window; the web service adds 1,000 remote lookups a day per service. Bulk path: the full GeoLite database downloads

limits.value: 1,000 web-service lookups a day per service
old database versions deleted within 30 days of a new release

binding_note: lookups against the downloaded databases are unmetered and 30 downloads a day is far more than the release cadence needs; only the web service carries a daily quota

identity_cost.detail: a MaxMind account: full name, company, industry, country and an email address that becomes the username; a license key is generated in the account portal; any field after the email address is unverified

reliability_note: MaxMind may stop offering GeoLite free of charge and charge for future updates; GeoLite City is less accurate than the paid GeoIP City data
confidence_note: No account was opened, so no database was downloaded; a keyed download would move it to measured.
